title: KODEX — KPILOT: agentic-AI
description:
KODEX — KPILOT (agentic-AI). fleet orchestration layer — routes a plain-language query to the right KODEX code and runs it; the LLM reasoning layer is the roadmap upgrade

Benchmark: fleet router: plain-language query → the right code (LLM agent = roadmap upgrade)

Part of KODEX, the Kronos Family of Codes — a benchmarked AI/ML fusion surrogate suite with calibrated uncertainty and an abstention gate (predict(x) → (y, uncertainty, in_domain)). Provenance: references 10.5281/zenodo.21842371. Home: https://kronosfusionenergy.com/kodex/kpilot · suite: https://github.com/KronosFE/kronos-ml. Licensed under Apache-2.0. Honest card preserved verbatim.
